name: Sadistic Passion
source:
Karin makes a delivery to a prestige school but ends up being an escort for the president of the Gentlemen's Club, Kyo. Karin is molested and harassed by his 'master' in order to please his sadistic desires. How will Karin get out of this mess without being sexually assaulted?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231228111354/http://renai.us/game/sadisticpassion]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
卡琳为名门学校送货，却最终成为绅士俱乐部会长京的护卫。为了满足主人施虐欲，卡琳遭到“主人”猥亵与骚扰。她要如何在不被性侵的情况下摆脱困境？

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231228111354/http://renai.us/game/sadisticpassion]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
